product.descriptionHtml:
Slide this glass water bottle into your bag and feel the cool, solid weight of real glass ready for the office or the train ride home. The natural cork clicks shut and the grey sleeve stays easy in your hand all day.

Why This Bottle Feels Right

  • 550 ml of clear borosilicate glass holds a full serving without feeling bulky.
  • Natural cork stopper seals cleanly and lifts off with one hand.
  • Grey silicone sleeve adds grip and cushions the glass.
  • BPA-free materials keep every sip simple and pure.

Clear Specs You Can Trust

This reusable glass water bottle is made of borosilicate glass, holds 550 ml, and comes with a natural cork stopper plus a grey silicone sleeve. It is priced at 28 USD.

Made for Office Desks and Commutes

Fill your glass drinking bottle before you leave and keep it at your desk or in your bag. The silicone sleeve makes it easy to grab between meetings, and the cork keeps water ready for the ride home.

Simple Care That Lasts

The glass is dishwasher-safe while the cork needs a quick hand-wash. Skip hot drinks and carbonated drinks so the bottle stays in top shape.
